title: AHB Reset Assertion and Safe Restart
description: Observe asynchronous HRESETn assertion, synchronous deassertion, the required IDLE bus state, and the first legal NONSEQ transfer after reset.

annotations.message: Before reset, the bus can carry a normal NONSEQ transfer.
HRESETn asserted asynchronously between sampling edges and is observed LOW here. The master immediately drives HTRANS to IDLE.
Reset remains active; address and control stay in a benign state.
HRESETn deasserts aligned with this rising HCLK edge. Keep HTRANS IDLE for a clean restart.
The first legal post-reset transfer starts with HTRANS=NONSEQ and a valid address.
